confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Dahab's budget-to-mid-range Red Sea tourist market, not from live listings. Restaurant and hostel anchors are moderately confident; the 3-star hotel anchor is the least certain because registered 3-star options in Dahab are limited and seasonal. Cocktail and wine anchors were set against the local beer price, with cocktail about 2.5x beer and wine a little above beer. The FX observation comes from search-result snippets for the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page; the page itself was not opened, and other snippets gave slightly different figures for nearby dates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against budget-tier Red Sea resort towns in Egypt, mainly Hurghada and Sharm el-Sheikh, with restaurant prices set somewhat below Sharm el-Sheikh because Dahab is a more backpacker-oriented town. Egypt is classed here under Middle East for Red Sea tourism pricing; Dahab sits on the Sinai Peninsula.
